28qi:
The practical nature of the University of Cumbria's degree ensures students will develop a complete range of production skills covering all aspects of the Film and TV making process from idea to finished product.

The University of Cumbria will focus on developing students' ‘voice’ as a creative. This is done through weekly practical tasks that build to a cohesive set of production skills.

The program will equip students with all they need to make great content and enhance their employability. Short films, multi-camera TV productions, documentaries, scriptwriting and experimental/music videos alongside regular workshops from professional practitioners will help them find their voice.

The University of Cumbria's production facilities and specialist staff provide all the tools and support students need to bring their creative ideas to life. Between them, the university's staff have over 20 years experience in this exhilarating and vibrant industry.
28tb:
Students will critically evaluate the relationships between international business strategy and operational needs, learn how to provide creative and innovative solutions through the essential attributes of management and leadership.

Students will be taught how to provide creative and innovative solutions through the essential attributes of management and leadership. Faculty will teach them to contextualize business management and practice across a range of public, private, and third stream organizations in local, regional, national, international, and global contexts.

In this course students will:

  • Gain awareness of the broader contexts and sphere of influence within which international business operates.
  • Study and practice international business management drawing on a range of perspectives in the fields of international marketing, strategic management, entrepreneurship and international human resources.
  • Develop their critical thinking, conceptual thinking and reasoning skills relating to international business and management.
  • Enhance their employability, career potential and personal effectiveness.
  • Develop their ability to carry out independent research in the field of business and management.
28sp:
Students will study management from a range of perspectives and address the big issues facing modern business. Industry-active tutors and resources will ensure learning stays current.

Students will become business-ready through access to the latest technology. Classroom activities, including leading lectures and mock office environments, will build managerial confidence. The University of Cumbria employer network will provide a strong practical insight, while challenge and creativity will develop student's problem-solving, decision-making and team-working skills.

Students will:

  • Develop the skills to bring change to organizations.
  • Learn how to meet the diverse needs of employees.
  • Learn how to shape an organizational vision.
  • Learn how to communicate effectively.
  • Develop confidence to lead others.
28rq:
Students will study the management of woodlands and forests for commercial, recreation, and conservation. their course will include modules on silviculture, woodland ecology, forest health, and forest management planning. Practical hands-on experience backs up theory and there will be an opportunity to go on an exchange to Humbolt State University in California.

Students will be well placed for a career as a professional forest manager both at home and overseas. The degree has a vocational focus and it is expected that as part of their course, they will acquire practical experience in forestry through employment, placements, work experience, and volunteer opportunities.
7n2n:
This BSc International Business Management program is crafted to equip students with the skills, knowledge, and behaviors needed to thrive in today's global business landscape. Inspired by the QAA Benchmark statement (2023), the university's curriculum is strategically designed to support student's growth from self-management to organizational leadership and beyond.

Throughout their journey, they will delve into crucial areas such as managing themselves and their teams, understanding internal and external contexts, and mastering product and service development. With a focus on digital transformation, sustainability, and ethical leadership, They will gain a holistic understanding of modern business practices and their impact on society.

This program offers unique opportunities to earn Digital Badges, develop essential employability skills, and engage with industry leaders through guest lectures and immersive learning experiences. Whether they aspire to entrepreneurship, corporate leadership, or social impact, this program empowers them to chart their path to success in the dynamic world of international business.
8ins:
This dynamic full-time programme offers the opportunity for individuals to extend their professional knowledge, enhancing their career profiles and prospects across a range of roles relevant to their contexts and interests. It provides a deeper understanding and expertise in the field of education, emphasizing the global outlook, cultural fluency, and the significance of social change valued in today’s employment market.

Suitable for educators in various settings, the programme focuses on employability and career advancement skills. It explores how the skills and knowledge gained can optimise employment opportunities. Through employer-led events, career guidance, and introductions to organizations offering optional voluntary practical experience, participants develop their professional profiles and become well-equipped to identify, accelerate, and navigate career progression opportunities.
28ub:
This course is for students who are inspired to work in the global business world with multi-national companies. This course will help them to secure the professional knowledge and skills to bolster their career in this fast-paced market.

Graduates will learn about international business practices, operations, sustainability and strategic management in the context of today’s complex and changing globalised marketplace.

Students will learn in a ‘global classroom’ alongside international students, where they can experience a social and cultural understanding of practice in other countries, helping to inform their cross-cultural business reasoning, practices and solutions. Plus, it gives them the opportunity to secure contacts across the globe.

Graduates’ learning will be enhanced with work-based projects and workshops giving them every opportunity to build their business confidence and give them an authentic insight into the scenarios and challenges that they will face in their future career.
902v:
The MBA Tourism and Visitor Economy Management is delivered face-to-face at Ambleside in the Lake District National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offering a real-world example of sustainable tourism.

Designed for professionals with a degree and experience, this MBA supports career growth through:

  • Industry expertise in every module.
  • UNESCO Sustainable Development Goals guiding ethical, innovative leadership.
  • Career-focused content to boost employability and inspire progression.

Whether advancing or entering the sector, this program prepares student to lead with insight and confidence.

Take the next step in the tourism career. Apply now and learn in one of the most inspiring places on Earth.

Study the MBA in the Lake District National Park. This face-to-face program combines academic and industry insight, embeds UN Sustainable Development Goals, and develops ethical leadership, strategic thinking, and practical skills. Gain hands-on experience through fieldwork and site visits to enhance the employability in a global sector.
28uc:
The Master of Business Administration (MBA) is for students whose career plan includes securing a high-level management position or becoming a successful entrepreneur. The Master of Business Administration (MBA) will open doors for students to work anywhere in the world and ultimately prove that they are an expert within their industry.

The intensive master’s degree is designed to integrate students' own work-based learning and teach them the academic rigor, skills and ethics to become a leader in business management, who can think logically and independently

University of Cumbria’s aim is for students to graduate with a globally recognized MBA, which proves their understanding of contemporary business and management principles and the current issues affecting organizations.

This program will stand students in excellent stead to secure business sustainability and give them the confidence to make high-end business decisions and the potential to become a leader in their field. An MBA is the primary management qualification for aspiring business leaders, giving students the skills and knowledge to progress their career to more senior levels or give them a stepping-stone to a new career.
